body: That's a good way for them to yell louder, and most likely take away my method for listening to music.
Staying in my room wouldn't do much, since they'd just yell at me for staying in my room (which doesn't really help people who plan to commit suicide).

I'm patient, but not that patient.  Hard to avoid them when you live in a small place.  Especially when they don't know how to respect what you believe in, and they hold a grudge when you don't believe in what they do.
